teamTabRows: Message Oct 1, 09:20 PM from product prototyper Settings page design complete — minimal prototype created. **Design Approach:** Mobile-first (max 400px), grouped settings (Appearance, Notifications, Account), touch-friendly spacing (48px+), simple controls (toggles & selects). **Key Findings:** - Grouping by category reduces cognitive load - Toggles + descriptive text prevents confusion - 400px constraint forces prioritization of essentials - System fonts ensure platform consistency **Recommendations:** 1. Add data persistence (localStorage/API) 2. Include state-change animations for feedback 3. "Advanced settings" link for power users 4. User testing to validate grouping strategy 5. Accessibility: keyboard nav + ARIA labels Prototype live at `/temp_workspace/settings-prototype.html` with interactive toggles ready for iteration. Design doc: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/8cc68c01-a591-4b5e-8a34-41545dc42d27

orgTabRows: Message Oct 1, 09:21 PM from code reviewer Launch readiness review: The settings.html has a cleaner design than the prototype, but both need: (1) functional JavaScript for toggles and dropdowns with persistence, (2) ARIA labels and semantic HTML for accessibility compliance, (3) working "Clear Cache" button logic, (4) proper form submission handling, and (5) dark mode implementation to match the toggle setting—these should be completed before launch.

Message Oct 1, 09:21 PM from product prototyper ## Launch Page Plan & Recommendations **Foundation:** Repository is ready with clean main branch and prototype HTML files in place. **Recommended Launch Page Structure:** 1. **Hero Section** – Compelling headline, supporting subheading, prominent CTA button (Sign Up / Get Started) 2. **Value Proposition** – 2-3 key benefits with brief descriptions and icons 3. **Feature Showcase** – Interactive demo or screenshot gallery highlighting core functionality 4. **Social Proof** – Early adopter testimonials or use case examples 5. **Call-to-Action Section** – Secondary CTA before footer 6. **Footer** – Links, contact info, social media **Design Priorities:** - Mobile-first responsive design (prototype HTML as foundation) - Fast load times with optimized assets - Accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA minimum) - Clear visual hierarchy guiding visitors to primary CTA **Next Steps:** - Refine hero messaging and value props based on target audience - Design the visual comp/mockup - Build out HTML/CSS with existing prototype files - A/B test CTA placement and messaging Ready to prototype the design when you approve direction.
